column1: manifest§His discomfort was manifest to everyone in the room except the person who was causing it.§他的不自在对屋里每个人都**显而易见**，除了造成这份不自在的那个人。§man（手，同 manual 手工的）+ fest（打击）→ 摆在手边看得见
manipulative§The question was manipulative rather than dishonest: it was true, and it was designed to produce one answer.§这个问题是**操纵性的**而非不诚实——它是真的，也是为了逼出某个答案而设计的。§man（手）+ pul（填塞）→ 用手摆布
mannered§The prose is so mannered that four pages in you notice the style and stop noticing the story.§这些文字**做作**到读了四页你只注意到文风，不再注意故事。§
masterful§Her masterful handling of a hostile room turned four opponents into abstentions within an hour.§她**娴熟老到地**驾驭一屋敌意，一小时内把四位反对者变成了弃权票。§master（大师）
materialist§The materialist explanation covers nine of the ten cases, and the tenth is the one everybody argues about.§**唯物主义的**解释涵盖十个案例中的九个，人人争论的是第十个。§
maternal§Her maternal grandmother kept the letters, and without that one decision the whole archive would be gone.§她的**外祖母**保存了这些信件，没有这一个决定，整批档案就没了。§mater（母亲）

matriarchal§The society is matriarchal in law and, as four decades of fieldwork show, considerably more complicated in practice.§这个社会在法律上是**母系的**，而正如四十年田野调查所示，实际情况复杂得多。§matri（母亲）+ arch（统治，同 monarch 君主）
maudlin§The speech turned maudlin after the fourth toast, and the recording was quietly never released.§第四轮祝酒后讲话变得**多愁善感**，录音被悄悄地一直没有发布。§源自哭泣的抹大拉的玛利亚 Magdalene
maverick§The maverick on the committee voted against every proposal for nine years and was right about two of them.§委员会里那位**特立独行者**九年来对每项提案都投反对票，其中两项他是对的。§Maverick（未给牛烙印的德州牧场主）
meager§The meager evidence supports a much smaller claim than the one the press release actually made.§这些**贫乏的**证据支持的论断，比新闻稿实际提出的小得多。§macer（瘦）
meaning§The meaning of the clause changed entirely when a comma was moved in the 1974 reprint.§1974 年重印时挪动了一个逗号，这一条的**含义**就完全变了。§
meddle§He meddled in a negotiation he did not understand and turned a small problem into a nine-month one.§他**插手**一场自己并不理解的谈判，把小问题变成了持续九个月的问题。§misc（混合，同 mix 混合）→ 掺一脚
meddler§The meddler was well-meaning, which made him far harder to keep out of the room.§这位**爱管闲事的人**是出于好意，这让他更难被挡在门外。§
mediate§A retired teacher mediated the dispute in one evening after the lawyers had failed for four months.§律师们失败四个月后，一位退休教师用一个晚上**调解**了这场纠纷。§medi（中间，同 medium 媒介）
mediator§The mediator's only rule was that neither side could describe the other's position, only its own.§这位**调解人**唯一的规矩是：任何一方都不能描述对方的立场，只能说自己的。§
medicinal§The plant has medicinal properties that were documented in 1610 and rediscovered, expensively, in 1994.§这种植物有 1610 年就有记载的**药用**性质，1994 年又被昂贵地重新发现。§medic（医疗，同 medicine 药）
mediocre§The film is mediocre and profitable, and the studio has since commissioned four more like it.§这部电影**平庸**而赚钱，制片厂此后又订制了四部类似的。§medi（中间）+ ocr（山峰）→ 卡在半山腰
mediocrity§Mediocrity survives here because nothing is ever measured, and nobody has asked for it to be.§**平庸**在这里得以存续，因为从没有什么被衡量过，也没人要求过。§
meditate§He meditated on the problem for four days and then solved it in a single afternoon.§他就这个问题**沉思**了四天，然后一个下午就解决了它。§medit（思量）
meditation§Twenty minutes of meditation each morning changed less about her mood than moving the alarm clock did.§每天早晨二十分钟的**冥想**对她情绪的改变，还不如挪一下闹钟。§
melancholy§A melancholy runs through the late paintings that the letters of the same years do not explain.§一种**忧郁**贯穿晚期画作，而同一时期的书信并不能解释它。§melas（黑）+ chole（胆汁）→ 黑胆汁致郁
melee§The melee outside the ground lasted nine minutes and produced four arrests and forty column inches.§球场外的**混战**持续九分钟，带来四次逮捕和四十栏英寸的报道。§
mellifluous§His mellifluous voice sold four decades of advertisements for products he privately refused to use.§他**甜美流畅的**嗓音为一些他私下拒绝使用的产品卖了四十年广告。§mell（蜂蜜，同 mellow 甘美的）+ flu（流，同 fluid 流体）
melodious§The melodious opening gives way, after nine bars, to something far harder to listen to.§**旋律优美的**开头在九小节后让位给远难入耳的东西。§melod（曲调，同 melody 旋律）
melodrama§The trial turned into melodrama the moment the second witness fainted, and the facts were never recovered.§第二位证人晕倒的那一刻审判变成了**通俗剧**，事实再没被找回来。§melo（音乐）+ drama（戏剧）
membranous§The membranous wing is thinner than paper and carries an insect four hundred miles without tearing.§这种**膜状的**翅膀比纸还薄，却能带着一只昆虫飞四百英里不破。§membran（薄膜）
memorable§The most memorable line in the film was improvised, and the writer has never been happy about it.§这部电影里最**令人难忘的**台词是即兴的，编剧对此一直不太高兴。§memor（记忆，同 memory 记忆）
mendacious§The mendacious footnote survived four editions because nobody thought to check a citation that supported everyone.§这条**说谎的**脚注熬过四个版本，因为没人想到去核对一条对谁都有利的引文。§mend（谎言）
mendacity§The mendacity was not the worst part; the worst part was how easily four institutions accepted it.§**谎言**并非最糟的部分，最糟的是四家机构接受它时有多轻易。§
mentor§Her mentor read every draft for nine years and never once put his name on any of them.§她的**导师**读了九年的每一份草稿，一次也没在上面署过自己的名字。§Mentor（《奥德赛》中受托教养之人）
mercenary§His motives were mercenary and he said so, which made him easier to negotiate with than the idealists.§他的动机是**唯利是图的**而且他明说了，这让他比理想主义者更好谈。§merc（报酬，同 commerce 商业）
mercurial§Her mercurial moods made the studio an unpredictable place to work and, four albums running, remarkably productive.§她**变化无常的**情绪让录音室成了难以预测的工作场所，也让连续四张专辑异常高产。§Mercury（信使之神／水银）
merge§The two departments merged in April, and eleven months later they still used different email systems.§两个部门在四月**合并**，十一个月后仍在用不同的邮件系统。§merg（浸没，同 submerge 淹没）
merriment§The merriment downstairs was audible through the floor, and upstairs four people were writing a resignation letter.§楼下的**欢闹**透过地板听得见，楼上四个人正在写辞职信。§merry（快活）
metaphorical§The phrase is metaphorical in the original and was taken literally by an entire generation of readers.§这个说法在原文中是**比喻性的**，却被整整一代读者照字面理解了。§meta（转换）+ phor（承载，同 metaphor 隐喻）
meteor§The meteor was seen by four hundred people and photographed, by chance, from a moving train.§这颗**流星**被四百人看见，还碰巧从一列行驶的火车上被拍了下来。§
methodical§Her methodical search of nine hundred files found what four inspired guesses had missed.§她**有条不紊地**搜查九百份卷宗，找到了四次灵光一闪的猜测都漏掉的东西。§method（方法）
meticulous§The meticulous notes he kept for forty years are now the only source for four of these events.§他四十年来记的**一丝不苟的**笔记，如今是这四起事件的唯一史料。§metic（畏惧）→ 怕出错而处处小心
metropolis§The metropolis grew by four hundred thousand in a decade, and the water system was designed in 1908.§这座**大都会**十年内增加了四十万人，而供水系统是 1908 年设计的。§metro（母亲）+ polis（城市，同 politics 政治）→ 母城
miff§She was miffed about the seating and, characteristically, said nothing about it for four days.§她因座位安排而**有些恼火**，也一如既往地四天没提这件事。§
migration§The migration takes nine weeks and passes over four countries, three of which permit hunting.§这次**迁徙**历时九周，飞越四个国家，其中三国允许狩猎。§migr（迁移，同 emigrate 移居国外）
milestone§The thousandth issue was a milestone that the staff marked by working an ordinary Tuesday.§第一千期是一座**里程碑**，员工们的纪念方式是照常上一个平常的周二班。§
mimic§The bird mimics four other species so well that recordings fool the birds themselves.§这种鸟**模仿**另外四个物种模仿得如此逼真，录音连那些鸟自己都能骗过。§
mindful§Mindful of what the last review had cost, she sent the draft to four people before submitting it.§**顾念**上一次评审的代价，她在提交前把草稿发给了四个人。§mind（心思）+ ful（充满）
minimize§They minimized the risk in every briefing and, in the internal memo, quantified it at one in nine.§他们在每次简报中**淡化**风险，在内部备忘录里却把它量化为九分之一。§minim（最小，同 minimum 最小值）
miraculous§The recovery was called miraculous by the press and, by her doctors, entirely consistent with the treatment.§媒体称这次康复是**奇迹般的**，而她的医生认为它与治疗完全吻合。§mir（惊奇，同 admire 钦佩）
misapplication§A misapplication of the formula understated the load by a factor of four, and nobody checked it twice.§公式的**误用**把荷载低估了四倍，而没有人复核过。§mis（错）+ application（应用）
misbehave§The instrument misbehaves above thirty degrees, which is why every reading from that August is suspect.§这台仪器在三十度以上**表现失常**，所以那年八月的每个读数都值得怀疑。§
mischievous§The mischievous footnote is the funniest thing in the book and cost the author two friendships.§那条**顽皮促狭的**脚注是全书最好笑的东西，也让作者失去了两段友谊。§mis（错）+ chief ← chever（发生，同 achieve 达成）
misconception§The misconception is nearly universal and takes about four sentences to correct, which nobody bothers to do.§这个**误解**几乎人尽皆有，纠正它约需四句话，而没人肯费这个事。§
miscreant§The miscreant turned out to be nine years old, and the entire security review was rewritten afterwards.§这名**作恶者**原来只有九岁，整份安全评估此后被重写了。§mis（错）+ cre（相信，同 credit 信用）→ 信错了道
miser§The miser left four hundred thousand pounds to a town that had thought him a charity case.§这位**吝啬鬼**给一座一直以为他需要救济的小镇留下了四十万英镑。§miser（悲惨，同 miserable 悲惨的）
misery§The misery of that winter is recorded in nine diaries, and no two of them agree about the cause.§那个冬天的**苦难**记录在九本日记里，没有两本对原因的说法一致。§
misgiving§Her misgivings about the contractor were recorded in an email that the inquiry later called prophetic.§她对承包商的**疑虑**记在一封邮件里，调查后来称之为预言。§mis（错／坏）+ giving（给出）→ 心里给出不好的预感
misguide§The advice misguided four hundred families, and the office that gave it has never issued a correction.§这条建议**误导**了四百个家庭，而发布它的办公室从未发过更正。§
mishandle§The department mishandled the evidence so badly that the case collapsed before it reached a jury.§这个部门对证据的**处理失当**严重到案子还没到陪审团就垮了。§
mishap§A small mishap in the first hour delayed a launch that had been scheduled for nine years.§第一小时的一次小**意外**推迟了一场筹划九年的发射。§mis（坏）+ hap（运气，同 happen 发生）
misinterpret§Readers misinterpret the sentence consistently, which suggests the fault is the writer's rather than theirs.§读者一致地**误解**这个句子，这说明错在作者而非他们。§
misjudge§He misjudged the room by about four minutes, and a joke that would have worked earlier fell flat.§他对现场的**判断**差了约四分钟，一个早些时候会奏效的玩笑冷了场。§
misnomer§"Freshwater dolphin" is a misnomer for an animal that spends four months a year in the sea.§对一种一年有四个月待在海里的动物，「淡水海豚」是个**用词不当**的名字。§mis（错）+ nom（名字，同 nominate 提名）
misrepresent§The summary misrepresents the study by omitting the sentence that limits it to one age group.§这份摘要漏掉了把研究限定在一个年龄组的那句话，从而**歪曲**了它。§mis（错）+ represent（表述）
missive§The missive from head office ran to nine pages and contained one instruction, on the last line.§总部来的这封**公函**长达九页，只在最后一行含有一条指令。§miss（送，同 mission 使命）
misstate§He misstated the figure in a hearing and corrected it in a letter that nobody reported.§他在听证会上**说错**了这个数字，并在一封无人报道的信里作了更正。§
mitigate§Nothing in the settlement mitigated the loss, though the insurer's letter spent four paragraphs suggesting otherwise.§和解方案里没有任何东西**减轻**了这笔损失，尽管保险公司的信用四段暗示并非如此。§mit（温和）+ ag（做）→ 使其变缓和
mitigator§Rainfall is the only real mitigator here, and the region has had four dry summers in a row.§降雨是这里唯一真正的**缓解因素**，而这个地区已连续四个夏天干旱。§
mock§Colleagues mocked the idea in 1998 and cited the paper describing it forty times in 2010.§同事们在 1998 年**嘲笑**这个想法，2010 年却把描述它的论文引用了四十次。§
mockery§The consultation was a mockery: four days' notice, one venue, and a decision already in the minutes.§这次咨询是个**笑话**——四天通知、一个会场，而决定已经写进了会议记录。§
